proposed_from.topic: Sharp lag-refinement bounds for micro controlled direct effects: for finite binary processes with directed effects restricted to positive lags 1,…,L, a bounded observed window, and a directed/bidirected summary causal graph, fix one common controlled direct-effect query over the positive-lag possible-parent set and define its envelope over all compatible full-time ADMG refinements and semi-Markovian SCMs reproducing an algebraically encoded positive observed law; compile the fiber into canonical response-function polynomial programs and prove terminating exact real-algebraic certification with derived bit complexity, endpoint attainment and SCM reconstruction, collapse to Ferreira–Assaad adjustment under their conditions, strict tightening over graph-free order-only bounds on a graphically characterized relative-open family, and simultaneous-multinomial whole-set inference with tie-aware EasyRCA comparisons. PRESOLVE EVIDENCE REQUIRING VERIFICATION: For N=|V|(H+1), bounded positive lags give finitely many full-time refinements; fixed-graph canonical response tables turn each refinement into a compact polynomial program, and real-algebraic quantifier elimination isolates attained endpoints and reconstructs algebraic-weight SCMs. In the binary temporal-IV witness, matching primal/dual calculations give graph-aware endpoints 0.285 and 0.685 versus order-only endpoints -0.1975 and 0.8025; every response-coupling cell is at least 0.005, so continuity plausibly extends strict tightening to a relative-open family. A rational box-simplex multinomial confidence polytope supplies simultaneous finite-sample coverage, with joint pairwise endpoint optimization reporting ties when effect differences include zero. Checks covered H=L, γ=L, cyclic summaries with acyclic positive-lag unrollings, bow graphs, non-clique bidirected districts, simplex boundaries, zero-cell confidence regions, and the closest fixed-graph, order-only, and summary-graph papers; no collision or counterexample was found. UNRESOLVED BOTTLENECK: Prove that merging observationally and query-equivalent response signatures preserves exactly the attainable (P,q) image and semi-Markovian factorization with overlapping independent latent parents, and derive the quotient-size bound. EARLY KILL TEST: On binary A↔B↔C with independent edge latents and one lagged arrow into C, exhaust raw and quotiented canonical signatures and compare their projected (P,q) semialgebraic sets by exact elimination; any separating witness forces an unquotiented pivot and kills the quotient-complexity claim.
proposed_from.novelty_justification: The closest identification comparator is DuarteEtAl2024, whose input is one specified canonical causal model; the proposed theorem instead identifies the exact envelope over every paper-restricted positive-directed-lag refinement of a cyclic or confounded summary graph, reconstructs endpoint SCMs, and returns exact branchwise incompatibility evidence when the union fiber is empty. The closest order-only comparator is RossettoAntonucci2026. The matched model here is one complete temporal-order SCM with arbitrary common-latent mass, and every refinement embeds by padding unused parents and bundling its independent edge latents. The exact graph-aware interval is strictly inside that complete comparator interval on a relative-open law family, with all four extrema and the interior witness reproducible from rational tables and pointwise inequalities. The closest reduction papers, RossettoAntonucci2026 and ChoeEtAl2026, rely on arbitrary simplex-mass lifts. Independent overlapping edge latents instead create a multilinear product image, so the proposal separates the always-sound push-forward image from the potentially larger unrestricted quotient-simplex image and requires an exact equality-or-separating-witness result before claiming reduction. Exact endpoint isolation, causal bit complexity, and simultaneous same-SCM contrast inference are not subsumed by the fixed-graph, PAG, or summary-adjustment papers found in the adjacent scan.

seed_details.seed: Sharp raw polynomial envelope over all bounded positive-lag refinements
seed_details.anchor_locator: Introduction; Theorem on controlled micro direct effects; Conclusion
seed_details.kernel: Equate the summary-graph CDE envelope with attained extrema of a finite union of fixed-refinement raw response-function polynomial images.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace Ferreira--Assaad's common do-calculus adjustment step outside their graphical regime by enumeration of compatible full-time ADMG refinements followed by fixed-graph canonicalization.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches for summary causal graph partial identification, temporal refinement bounds, and micro controlled direct effect bounds found no paper optimizing over the refinement union.
seed_details.red_team: Immediate from Duarte et al. because each refinement is a discrete causal model.
seed_details.rebuttal: Duarte et al. require one specified causal model; the nontrivial claims are equality to the union summary fiber, a common query across changing parent sets, and reconstruction that retains edge-latent factorization branch by branch.

seed_details.seed: Factorization-safe response-signature quotient or exact separating witness
seed_details.anchor_locator: Equation defining signature equivalence; theorem on the reduced linear program; Appendix reverse lift by uniform within-cell mass
seed_details.kernel: Characterize exactly when observationally and query-equivalent response signatures admit a lift that remains in the overlapping independent edge-latent product image.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace arbitrary within-cell redistribution by a local congruence and tensor-factor lift respecting every shared endpoint of the latent-incidence graph.
seed_details.destination_search: The destination search found Choe et al. 2026 Proposition 3.1, but it also lifts from an unrestricted simplex and explicitly limits the result to linear objectives and constraints.
seed_details.red_team: Immediate from Rossetto--Antonucci or Choe et al. because equal columns define a safe quotient.
seed_details.rebuttal: Equal columns preserve a linear image of arbitrary masses, whereas independent overlapping edge latents restrict raw global masses to a nonlinear product image; the published selector or uniform lift need not lie in that image.

seed_details.seed: Exact real-algebraic endpoint isolation with decoded SCM certificates
seed_details.kernel: Compile the refinement disjunction into first-order real formulas, isolate attained algebraic endpoints, derive bit and output-size bounds, and decode sample points into SCMs.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace spatial branch-and-bound and asymptotic gap closure by exact quantifier elimination with algebraic sample-point extraction and a causal response-table decoder.
seed_details.destination_search: Geiger--Meek and Basu--Pollack--Roy occupy generic elimination and complexity, but no adjacent paper instantiates the encoding and decoder for a temporal refinement union.
seed_details.red_team: A direct invocation of Tarski--Seidenberg adds no causal theorem.
seed_details.rebuttal: The proposal derives the polynomial count, degree, coefficient height, response-coordinate count, attained endpoint representation, and graph-compatible SCM decoding from causal inputs; those are absent from the generic theorem.

seed_details.seed: Exact graphical collapse frontier around Ferreira--Assaad adjustment
seed_details.anchor_locator: Theorem on controlled micro direct effects; Proposition on adjustment necessity without hidden confounding; Conclusion open problem
seed_details.kernel: Give an if-and-only-if summary-graph criterion for the refinement envelope to collapse to their adjustment functional under hidden confounding.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: At the necessity direction, replace failure of adjustment by a same-positive-law pair of full-time refinements with unequal common-parent CDEs.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches found the 2024 linear no-confounding completeness result and the 2026 nonparametric sufficient theorem, but no hidden-confounding sharp collapse frontier.
seed_details.red_team: Already stated as a future-work necessity question by Ferreira--Assaad, so the seed merely repeats it.
seed_details.rebuttal: The intended necessity object is stronger and different: constancy of a sharp refinement-union CDE envelope at one positive observed law, certified by paired SCMs, not adjustment-identifiability alone.

seed_details.seed: Relative-open strict tightening over graph-free order-only bounds
seed_details.anchor_locator: Introduction contribution list; exact-bounds theorem; complexity discussion; Conclusion
seed_details.kernel: Exhibit exact temporal-instrument primal and dual certificates and propagate both endpoint gaps to a relative-open family of positive laws.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Intersect the order-only signature simplex with the summary-refinement product images and construct a dual separator excluding both order-only endpoint faces.
seed_details.destination_search: Bellot 2024 proves tighter-than-natural PAG bounds but does not characterize a temporal summary-graph micro-CDE open family.
seed_details.red_team: A single hand-tuned temporal-IV table proves no durable identifying value.
seed_details.rebuttal: Strict rational primal-dual margins plus positive response cells imply persistence on a relative-open graph-compatible neighborhood.

seed_details.seed: Finite refinement enumeration and horizon-size bounds
seed_details.kernel: Bound and enumerate every positive-lag refinement compatible with a fixed summary graph on a bounded window.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace repeated-column hedge cutting in one periodic graph by candidate edge-placement counting over all lag refinements.
seed_details.destination_search: No paper found combines their known-graph finite segment with unknown summary-graph refinement enumeration.
seed_details.red_team: Finite edge-subset counting is elementary and cannot support a paper.
seed_details.rebuttal: The objection holds for a standalone seed; the lemma is retained only as infrastructure for the sharp envelope and complexity theorem.

seed_details.seed: Simultaneous multinomial inference for the complete endpoint vector
seed_details.anchor_locator: Definition 2; Theorem 1 and counting proof; discussion of linear-functional intervals
seed_details.kernel: Propagate one uniformly covered multinomial region through every refinement-union endpoint and every same-SCM query contrast.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace linear projection of the multinomial parameter by exact min and max over a nonsmooth finite union of latent-variable polynomial fibers.
seed_details.destination_search: Duarte et al. propagate uncertainty for one fixed program; Fang--Santos treats directional limits, but no source gives finite-sample whole-vector coverage over a refinement union.
seed_details.red_team: Coverage follows immediately from set inclusion and is only a Bonferroni exercise.
seed_details.rebuttal: Coverage transfer is simple, but exact boundary-aware joint contrast optimization, same-SCM coupling, and a single event covering active-refinement switches are the substantive computational-statistical object; it remains an attached rung rather than the sole kernel.

seed_details.seed: Tie-aware same-SCM direct-effect comparisons for EasyRCA
seed_details.anchor_locator: Introduction; Proposition 7 adjustment set; Theorem 1; Conclusion
seed_details.kernel: Rank root-cause candidates by jointly optimized CDE differences and declare ties exactly when zero remains compatible with the confidence fiber.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace point estimates of normal-versus-anomalous direct effects by a coupled latent-refinement optimization for each pairwise difference.
seed_details.destination_search: No EasyRCA follow-on located in the scan uses partially identified envelopes or simultaneous zero-feasibility ties.
seed_details.red_team: This is a decision rule layered on bounds, not a theorem-level causal contribution.
seed_details.rebuttal: The objection holds as a standalone angle; the rule remains a concrete consumer of the simultaneous same-SCM contrast theorem.

seed_details.seed: Summary-graph analogues of PAG analytical bounds
seed_details.anchor_locator: Propositions 3--5; Partial IDP soundness proposition; Conclusion
seed_details.kernel: Derive closed-form micro-CDE bounds from possible ancestors, parents, and spouses in a temporal summary graph without enumerating response functions.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace PAG bucket and possible-spouse decomposition by lag-indexed possible-parent sets across cyclic summary refinements.
seed_details.destination_search: The scan found no closed-form SCG analogue, but cycles and independent edge latents prevent a faithful direct transfer of the PAG decomposition.
seed_details.red_team: The PAG inequalities transfer by renaming possible ancestors and are therefore routine.
seed_details.rebuttal: The attempted transfer fails at cyclic temporal refinements and non-clique districts, leaving no defensible closed form in v1; the seed is dropped rather than padded.

seed_details.seed: Exact confidence-fiber endpoint certification at zero empirical cells
seed_details.anchor_locator: Inference section on Bernoulli--Kullback--Leibler regions; Algorithm 3; conclusion
seed_details.kernel: Accept a rational closed multinomial polytope and return exact algebraic outer endpoints even when its faces meet the probability-simplex boundary.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace floating-point confidence constraints and numerical branch-and-bound by closed semialgebraic optimization with algebraic boundary sample points.
seed_details.destination_search: Malloy et al. settle confidence-region coverage but not nonlinear causal-image optimization; no closer exact causal confidence-fiber certificate was found.
seed_details.red_team: This is automatic once the population exact-certification theorem is available.
seed_details.rebuttal: Embedding the unknown law as a decision variable and preserving a shared same-SCM contrast across simplex faces require an augmented closed semialgebraic program, but the contribution is best integrated into inference rather than sold independently.

proposed_from.literature_map: The chosen kernel sits at an unoccupied intersection. FerreiraAssaad2026 fixes the micro-CDE target and proves a sufficient common adjustment formula but no sharp set outside it. DuarteEtAl2024 proves fixed-graph canonical polynomialization and numerical convergence; ArroyoEtAl2025 treats quasi-Markovian fixed graphs and excludes overlapping-confounder vertices. JahnKarnikSchulman2025 gives a bounded segment for one known periodic ADMG, not a summary-refinement union. RossettoAntonucci2026 and ChoeEtAl2026 give exact quotient lifts only for unrestricted simplex linear programs; their reverse lifts do not enforce a nonlinear independent-edge-latent product image. Evans2016 and Evans2021 explain why hidden-variable margins and dependence constructions can retain structure erased by mixed-graph or local summaries. GeigerMeek1999 and BasuPollackRoy1996 establish exact elimination and generic complexity but no causal compiler-size instantiation or SCM decoder. Bellot2024 proves sound PAG bounds and possible strict improvement, without a temporal micro-CDE relative-open certificate. MalloyTripathyNowak2020 covers the full multinomial parameter, and EasyRCA2023 supplies the downstream point-effect comparison, but neither handles simultaneous refinement-union endpoints and same-SCM contrasts.
